title: Entities, aggregates, value objects and repositories

videos.script: Lesson eleven drew the borders. This one moves in. {{borders}} The patterns here are small, and they are where the rules of a business actually live. Inside the lending context live a handful of shapes, and each one answers a question. First, which things keep their identity while everything about them changes. A member who changes her name is still the same member. {{entities}} Then which things are only their values. Fifty cents is fifty cents, and nobody asks which. {{values}} Then the rule that a member may hold five loans, and where it has to live so that nobody can break it. {{aggregate}} Lending touches a member and a copy. You will see what happens when one says yes and the other says no. {{boundary}} Then storage. The same code runs against a dictionary and against SQLite, and cannot tell them apart. {{repository}} Then the model saying what happened, so that receipts and notices are sent by somebody else. {{events}} And last, a rule that belongs to nobody: the days the library was closed for Carnaval. {{service}}
